card.line: Meribah, meaning quarrel, was a name for waters in the wilderness where Israel quarreled with the LORD and tested Him, and where Moses and Aaron rebelled.

moments.title: Israel tests the LORD
moments.text: At the rock at Horeb, the LORD told Moses to strike the rock so the people could drink. Moses named the place Massah and Meribah because Israel quarreled and asked, "Is the LORD among us or not?"

moments.title: The LORD shows His holiness
moments.text: The LORD told Moses and Aaron they did not trust Him to show His holiness. So they would not bring the assembly into the land. These were the waters of Meribah, where Israel quarreled with the LORD.

moments.title: Aaron will not enter the land
moments.text: Near Mount Hor, the LORD said Aaron would be gathered to his people. He would not enter the land because Moses and Aaron rebelled against His command at the waters of Meribah.

moments.title: Moses told he will die too
moments.text: The LORD told Moses he would also be gathered to his people. He said both brothers rebelled against His command to show His holiness at the waters of Meribah in Kadesh. Moses then asked for a leader for Israel.
